issue: Blocked task offers no editing path at all; description and priority cannot be changed
actual: For blocked task 4 ("Complete tax filing", blocked by "Review project proposal"), the edit button [data-semtag-id='tasks.list.item.4.edit'] is fully disabled (button.disabled === true), as is the complete button. Programmatically clicking it does not open the task form (formPresent=false). The card exposes only complete (disabled), edit (disabled) and delete (enabled) — no inline or partial editor. Therefore the user cannot change the blocked task's description or priority, which the requirement says must remain available; the title/deadline restriction is enforced only by blocking all editing.
evidence: Card controls: complete disabled=true, edit disabled=true, delete enabled. Same pattern on blocked tasks 7 and QA Full Task (edit.enabled=false).

Blocked tasks (4, 7, QA Full Task) report complete.state="blocked" vs "active" for unblocked, carry a visible blocked-warning element, and their complete toggle is disabled (enabled=false / button.disabled=true), so completion is unavailable while prerequisites are incomplete.

Single incomplete prerequisite names it: task 4 shows 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; QA Full Task shows 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete'. Multiple prerequisites report a count: task 7 shows "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray "6,4") link dependent tasks, each with a 16px transparent hit path. Hovering the connector between "Review project proposal" and "Submit final report" highlights it (class stroke-warning/50 → stroke-primary) and opens a popup: "Dependency Chain — Submit final report: pending, Review project proposal: pending, Complete tax filing: pending", i.e. the chain plus each task's completion state.

Hovering blocked-warning of task 7 ("2 prerequisites incomplete") opens tooltip "Dependency Chain — Review project proposal: pending, Complete tax filing: pending", identifying both still-pending prerequisites and their states.

Active view (show-active selected) listed only the 7 active tasks with label "Active 7"; clicking show-completed switches selection and the list shows only the 2 completed tasks (Reply to client emails, Organize desk) with label "Completed 2". tasks.summary reads "7 active, 2 completed" in both.

Cards show title + priority badge always (e.g. "Complete tax filing"/"High"); description and deadline render when supplied ("Gather all documents..."/"Sep 11") and are omitted otherwise (QA No Deadline has no deadline shown); blocking state exposed via blocked-warning ('Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'). Completed tasks are visually distinct: title class "line-through text-muted-foreground", card "bg-muted/50".

Clicked complete on active task "Buy groceries". It disappeared from the active list; counts moved from "7 active, 2 completed" to "6 active, 3 completed" (Active 7→6, Completed 2→3). It now appears in the completed view with complete.state="completed".

After completing "Buy groceries" it was not deleted: completed count rose 2→3 and the task is listed in the completed view alongside "Reply to client emails" and "Organize desk", retaining its priority (Low) and deadline (Tomorrow), with both reopen (complete toggle) and delete actions still available.

While prerequisite "Buy groceries" was incomplete, "QA Full Task" had complete.state="blocked" and its complete toggle disabled (enabled=false), so it could not be completed. After completing "Buy groceries", QA Full Task became state="active" with the complete toggle enabled and label "1 prerequisite completed"; clicking it completed the task (counts 6 active/3 completed → 5 active/4 completed). Blocked tasks 4 and 7 remain non-completable while their prerequisites are incomplete.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked, and permanently stuck in that state
actual: Sequence: completed "Buy groceries" → its dependent "QA Full Task" unblocked → completed "QA Full Task" (5 active, 4 completed) → reopened "Buy groceries" from the completed view. The app neither prevented the reopen nor reverted the dependent. "QA Full Task" now remains in the completed view with data-semtag-state="completed" and line-through styling, while simultaneously rendering the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete'. It is counted as completed (6 active, 3 completed). Worse, its complete toggle is disabled (button.disabled=true) and its edit button is disabled, so the user cannot un-complete or edit it — the task is locked in a contradictory completed+blocked state, recoverable only by deletion.
